nested_parent_detachment.evidence: Independent targeted test `test_owned_rooted_filesystem_worker_rejects_detached_nested_parent_at_each_boundary` passed as part of the focused run. It injects parent directory/symlink replacement before/during/after link, before receipt, and between worker return and parent acceptance. Worker rejects observed detachments and only removes entries whose inode is proven to be its own.
nested_parent_detachment.limitation: Source docs state no portable atomic operation pins an entire directory ancestry across path-relative filesystem operations; checkpoint-bounded checks do not guarantee against a swap/restore or a race after the final check. This is accurately scoped, not a claim of universal atomicity.
